ety.text: According to Jacques Rousseau, it is cited to be from an Amerindian language meaning "log", which however does not adequately describe how the term originally referred to a buckwheat pancake. Its usage as a term for a felled log being floated to a mill may be explained as a reference to a log's resemblance to a rolled pitoune.
